Our Structure

Organisational Chart

The governance and operational structure of St. Elizabeth Catholic Hospital under the Goaso Diocesan Health Service — 42 posts across six reporting lines.

Bishop of Goaso Diocese
Supreme spiritual and administrative authority over all diocesan health institutions.
Diocesan Health Service Board
Governance board setting policy and strategic direction for diocesan health services.
Director of Health Service
Directs the diocesan health service and oversees all member institutions.
Hospital Manager
Sr. Georgina Lawrentia Quayson
Heads the hospital day to day, with the four departmental leads reporting in.
Medical Director
Dr. Kofi Kofo Boakye
Leads clinical services, specialist care, diagnostics and public health programmes.
Administrator
Runs HR, finance, estates, logistics, ICT, procurement and quality assurance.
Nurse Manager
Mrs. Gladys Bediako
Oversees nurse specialists, nurses, midwives and ward assistants.
Chaplain
Rev.Fr. Mathew Kumi
Provides counselling and pastoral care to patients, staff and families.
Internal Auditor
Reports independently of hospital management, directly to the Director of Health Service.

Select + / − on a post to show or hide the units reporting to it.

Goaso Diocesan Health Service

St. Elizabeth Catholic Hospital operates under the governance of the Goaso Diocesan Health Service Board, in alignment with the Catholic Diocese of Goaso and the Christian Health Association of Ghana (CHAG).
